incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.alerts.shadow_mismatch - Live meter ~11% below shadow for eu-south starting 2026-06-02T14:40Z. Potential overage flags.
erin-oncall: taking pager. Paging @sam-billing and @ryan-sre. Any infra changes?
sam-billing: seeing 7 overage_flags emitted. Shadow ledger steady. Samples: tx-5b7, tx-9ff.
ryan-sre: quick health check: emitter consumers show partition 0 lag=0, partition 1 lag=14200. Looks like one consumer stalled.
ops-bot: k8s: restarting pod/emitter-consumer-1 in eu-south.
ryan-sre: pod had repeated "GC pause > 6s" and commit timeouts before restart. Restarting now.
erin-oncall: pause automated billing emails for eu-south; CS to notify affected customers "investigating - no charges yet".
mira-cs: paused emails and notified top 3 customers; template approved.
ops-bot: restart complete, consumer lag dropping to 800 and decreasing.
ryan-sre: kicking off backfill for window 2026-06-02T13:50Z-14:40Z: `meter-backfill --shard 1 --from 13:50 --to 14:40` job=bf-1789990002-a
sam-billing: holding invoices until recon done. If backfill clears delta <1% we'll auto-clear flags.
ops-bot: backfill bf-1789990002-a status: running -> 60% -> done
sam-billing: reconciler run complete: 7 flags cleared, no charges applied. CS confirms customers were notified and satisfied.
erin-oncall: root cause = single emitter consumer GC/OOM causing delayed commits -> live tally lag -> false overage flags. Fixes: restart, backfill/reconcile, pause emails. Follow-ups: SRE task to add liveness probe and heap tuning; BILL task to add transient-drift suppression.
ops-bot: Pager resolved: metering.alerts.shadow_mismatch severity=P2 duration=47m
